import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_D = 64, MAX_LOG = 65;

    static long n, d;
    static ArrayList<Long> digits = new ArrayList<>();

    static class Node {
        long[][] dp = new long[MAX_D][MAX_D];
        long[][] cnt = new long[MAX_D][MAX_D];
        boolean[] mark = new boolean[MAX_D];
        boolean[] temp = new boolean[MAX_D];

        void merge(Node other) {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAX_D; j++) {
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; ++j) {
                    for (int k = 0; k <= d; ++k) {
                        cnt[i][j] = (cnt[i][j] + dp[k][j] * other.dp[i][k]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < d; ++i) {
                if (mark[i] && !other.mark[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; ++j)
                        cnt[i][j] = dp[i][j];
                }
                if (!mark[i] && other.mark[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; ++j)
                        cnt[j][i] = other.dp[j][i];
                }
                mark[i] = mark[i] || other.mark[i];
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAX_D; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = cnt[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        void clear() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAX_D; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = 0;
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void shift(int x) {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAX_D; j++) {
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < d; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < d; ++j) {
                    cnt[(i + x) % d][(j + x) % d] = dp[i][j];
                }
                cnt[(i + x) % d][d] = dp[i][d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; ++i) {
                cnt[d][(i + x) % d] = dp[d][i];
            }
            cnt[d][d] = dp[d][d];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAX_D; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = cnt[i][j];
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < d; ++i) {
                temp[i] = mark[(i + x) % d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                mark[i] = temp[i];
            }
        }
    }

    static Node[] segmentTree = new Node[MAX_LOG];
    static Node[] prefixTree = new Node[MAX_LOG];
    static Node tempNode = new Node();

    static Node getPrefixNode(long x) {
        long h = x, power = 1, level = -1;
        while (h >= d) {
            h /= d;
            power *= d;
            ++level;
        }
        x %= power;
        if (level == -1) return prefixTree[(int)h];
        Node result = segmentTree[(int)level];
        tempNode = new Node();
        tempNode = segmentTree[(int)level];
        for (int i = 1; i < h; ++i) {
            tempNode.shift(1);
            result.merge(tempNode);
        }
        tempNode = getPrefixNode(x);
        tempNode.shift((int)h);
        result.merge(tempNode);
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        n = scanner.nextLong();
        d = scanner.nextLong();
        --n;
        long original = n;
        while (n > 0) {
            digits.add(n % d);
            n /= d;
        }

        // Initialize segmentTree and prefixTree arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_LOG; i++) {
            segmentTree[i] = new Node();
            prefixTree[i] = new Node();
        }

        prefixTree[0].dp[(int)d][(int)d] = 2;
        prefixTree[0].dp[(int)d][0] = -1;
        prefixTree[0].dp[0][(int)d] = 1;
        prefixTree[0].mark[0] = true;
        segmentTree[0] = prefixTree[0];

        for (int i = 1; i < d; ++i) {
            prefixTree[i].dp[(int)d][(int)d] = 2;
            prefixTree[i].dp[(int)d][i] = -1;
            prefixTree[i].dp[i][(int)d] = 1;
            prefixTree[i].mark[i] = true;
            segmentTree[0].merge(prefixTree[i]);
            prefixTree[i] = segmentTree[0];
        }

        for (int level = 1; level <= digits.size(); ++level) {
            segmentTree[level] = new Node();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAX_D; j++) {
                    segmentTree[level].dp[i][j] = segmentTree[level-1].dp[i][j];
                }
            }
            tempNode = new Node();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_D; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAX_D; j++) {
                    tempNode.dp[i][j] = segmentTree[level-1].dp[i][j];
                }
            }
            for (int j = 1; j < d; ++j) {
                tempNode.shift(1);
                segmentTree[level].merge(tempNode);
            }
        }

        Node answer = getPrefixNode(original);
        System.out.println(answer.dp[(int)d][(int)d]);
    }
}
